plain.li: [leave] Let's go and make a home of it.
[leave] Last look back, then the road.
[leave] Somewhere out there is our new hearth.
[seeoff] Send word when the first roof is up.

warm.li: [leave] Whatever we find there, it'll be ours.
[seeoff] Wherever you settle, you're still ours.

gloomy.li: [seeoff] It won't be the same here without you.

plain.li: First night under our own sky.
Tomorrow we start on the walls.
Pass the pot round, there's enough for everyone.
I wonder what they're doing back home tonight.
Listen to it out there, nothing but wind.
[lowtech,fire] The fire caught on the first try, which is a good sign.
[child] Is this where we live now?
[speaker,fire] We came a long way to sit round this fire, so let's make it worth the walk.
[speaker] Whatever we build here, we build it together.
[speaker] Tonight we rest, and tomorrow this place starts to become home.

warm.li: I'm glad it's you lot I came with.
[speaker,fire] Look around this fire, because these are the people who made this colony.

cheerful.li: A whole new place, and it's ours to name.

gloomy.li: I hope we didn't leave too much behind.

cold.li: We have work to do in the morning.
